worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.summary: Scoops up a fistful of sand heated by the earth and flings it freely at a point: the sand arcs along a real parabola, bursts open, scalds everyone inside and may set them alight; in Smoulder form the natural sand near the impact is heated cell by cell, and only a foot touching one of those hot cells is scorched. Standing on sand scoops more, scorching sand sticks worse to a wet target, and non-sandy ground gets only the initial burst with no hot zone.
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.use.0: Scald a group around a point with a fistful of hot sand
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.use.1: Pre-bake a connected hot zone along natural sand
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.use.2: Scoop more sand and spread wider on sandy ground
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.use.3: Scorch a wet target for extra damage
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.descrip: The impact hits each enemy once for about %1$s special damage. A wet target receives a ×1.15 power multiplier.
Range %1$s blocks; the sand flies at %2$s blocks/tick along a real parabola and bursts in a %3$s block radius.
A hit has a %1$s chance to burn. In Smoulder form up to about %2$s natural sand cells near the impact are heated cell by cell for %3$s; non-sandy ground leaves no hot zone.

In Smoulder form the hot zone lasts the same time. Only enemies whose feet touch an actual hot cell take about %1$s special damage every %2$s; each entry separately has a %3$s chance to burn; a cell covered by water or dug away stops working.
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.rule.sa: Casting from sand or sandstone multiplies impact power by 1.08 and raises the heatable natural-sand cell budget by about 40%. Only a foot touching a real hot sand cell is scorched: stepping over, a stone island or being airborne is safe. When the ground turns to water or the sand is dug away, that cell stops working.
Smoulder: x0.88 burst power, but the natural sand near the impact is heated cell by cell into a connected hot zone, burns more readily on entry and lasts longer, with +8 cooldown.
Red sand: x1.08 burst power, and the sand scatters without heating the ground, with -3 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
From level %1$s the burst rises to %2$s power and %3$s burn chance.
From level %1$s the burst rises to %2$s power and the radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.prefere: On: x0.88 burst power, but the sand left behind keeps smouldering, burns more readily on entry and lasts longer, with +8 cooldown, for locking down ground. Off (red sand): x1.08 burst power and inert sand, with -3 cooldown, for burst.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: a target with other enemies nearby ranks first so the fistful covers them too; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.burn: Being set alight means burn: it lasts 40 seconds, draining 1/16 of the target's maximum health every 5 seconds (at least 1) and halving the physical damage it deals; Fire-type targets cannot be burned, and the burn can be cleansed early.
